normative_extracts.quote: Run the update intersection observations steps as part of the rendering pipeline after layout and before paint.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: IntersectionObserver reads already-computed layout boxes inside the rendering pipeline and delivers batched visibility deltas asynchronously without triggering synchronous reflow.

production_failures.symptom: Scroll performance degrades to 20fps with forced synchronous layouts
production_failures.root_cause: Replacing IntersectionObserver with a scroll listener calling getBoundingClientRect() on 50 cards triggers Layout Thrashing on every scroll tick.
production_failures.mitigation: Observe target elements with a single shared IntersectionObserver instance.

production_failures.symptom: Sticky header intersection callback never fires or fires at wrong offset
production_failures.root_cause: Observing visibility against the wrong root or omitting rootMargin when a fixed 64px header covers the top of the viewport.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass rootMargin: '-64px 0px 0px 0px' or observe a 1px sentinel element.
